fields.name: Resilience strategy
fields.definition: The policy ArgentSea applies to every command it executes on a data connection: retry with retry backoff on transient errors, wrapped by a circuit breaker. Each read or write endpoint has its own policy instance. It is built from the `RetryCount`, `RetryInterval`, `RetryLengthening`, `CircuitBreakerFailureCount` and `CircuitBreakerTestInterval` settings, with built-in defaults for any that are unset, and is rebuilt when the endpoint's retry count or circuit-breaker settings change. The provider driver's own connection retries are turned off so that every retry goes through, and is logged by, this policy.
